patch_description:
Replaces the current RY+CNOT_ring+RX ansatz with a more expressive RY+RZ+CZ(ring+cross)+RZ design. This builds on the proven best prior (RY+RZ+CZ_line+RZ) with two key topology improvements:
1. Ring CZ closure (adding [7,0]) ensures all qubits have symmetric connectivity
2. Cross CZ connections ([0,4], [1,5], [2,6], [3,7]) create antipodal links, reducing the effective graph diameter to 2 and allowing features encoded on distant qubits to interact within a single block
3. Even-odd CZ ordering enables parallel execution, keeping depth manageable

The RZ sandwich around entanglement directly manipulates Z-phase information from the IsingZZ feature map. Same 24 params/block (146 total) as the best prior, but with richer entanglement topology.
